scene: Antique ink-and-watercolour landscape painted on paper, the whole sheet one continuous scene, in the manner of Arthur Rackham and John Bauer: faded desaturated pigments (sepia, umber, moss, slate, tarnished gold), loose wet washes, pigment blooms, faint pencil underdrawing, dark fairy-tale mood. NO text, NO figures, NO creatures, NO frame, NO border. A sheltered garden valley seen at ground level, horizon at 38% from the top of the image on every panel, light from the upper left, the lower 45% calm and mostly empty ground where small creatures will stand.
subject: Panel 1 of 6, the far left: the woodland edge, old twisted trunks and ferns at the left side, the trees thinning toward the right.
